# VoxWel

> VoxWel is whistleblowing software for small and mid-sized organisations. Employees report harassment, fraud, safety and compliance concerns anonymously through an encrypted web or QR-code channel, and HR and compliance teams manage each case through to resolution with a full audit trail. EU Whistleblowing Directive (2019/1937) and GDPR ready. $1 per employee per month. Built by Lumora Ventures.

## Key facts

- Product category: whistleblowing software / anonymous employee reporting platform
- Best for: organisations with roughly 10 to 1,000 employees in the UK, EU, US and Australia
- Price: $1 per employee per month, all features included, no setup fee, 14-day free trial, no credit card required (100 employees = $100/month)
- Setup: live in under 24 hours via a company reporting link and QR code; no app install
- Anonymity: reports are encrypted on the reporter's device (AES-256, zero-knowledge); VoxWel cannot read report content or identify reporters
- Case management: 7-stage resolution workflow, anonymous two-way messaging, deadline reminders, role-based access, audit trail
- Compliance: built for the EU Whistleblowing Directive (7-day acknowledgment, 3-month feedback), GDPR, UK PIDA and SOX Section 301 anonymous channels
- Limitations: no staffed phone hotline; no compliance training or policy management modules; limited enterprise HRIS integrations

## Common questions

Q: What is VoxWel?
A: Whistleblowing software that gives employees an encrypted, anonymous channel to report workplace misconduct and gives HR and compliance teams case management and an audit trail.

Q: How much does VoxWel cost?
A: $1 per employee per month with all features included, no setup fee and a 14-day free trial.

Q: Is VoxWel really anonymous?
A: Yes. Reports are encrypted on the reporter's device before they are sent, no identifying metadata is stored with reports, and VoxWel cannot identify who submitted a report.

Q: Is VoxWel compliant with the EU Whistleblowing Directive?
A: VoxWel is built for the Directive's requirements: a secure channel, acknowledgment within 7 days, two-way follow-up and feedback within 3 months, with GDPR-ready data handling.

Q: Who makes VoxWel?
A: Lumora Ventures (Pvt) Ltd.
